## At work

I'm in the middle of refactoring a data pipeline — the
one that's been held together with intensely manual steps and institutional
memory for toooo long.

## On the side

Revamping this website and building a "digital twin" resume app in Python — 
a small RAG application that answers questions about my work experience 
from my own documents. It's an excuse to get deep into hexagonal architecture, 
ports-and-adapters patterns, and the kinds of Python generics that feel 
abstract until you actually need them. Ingestion, embeddings and retrieval 
work, the front end is next.

## Tooling

Leaning hard into Claude Code right now — specifically, using it with
Obsidian as a thinking and writing environment. Configuring skills from
community repos, working out sensible sandboxing The goal is an AI-assisted 
workflow for my  "second brain" where I can just shout ideas into the void
and they get organized and linked without thinking about it. Next I want to
get openWhispr up and running on fedora using my local AI stack.


## Off the computer

Getting outdoor house projects we've been putting off for years! First up is
replacing the outside flood lights without falling off my ladder.
